column1: # Known differences between scopeio and the reference readers, which read ScanImage files as plain
# TIFF: every page a time point of one channel, flyback frames and the fly-to rows between regions
# of interest included. scopeio maps the pages to channels, z (slices of a volume) and time from the
# acquisition settings, skips flyback frames and returns each region of interest as a series; the
# placement of every page is checked with the synthetic pixel values (tests/scanimage.rs).
# Bio-Formats reports the 72 dpi placeholder resolution of older releases (352777.778 nm); scopeio
# takes the pixel size from the imaging field of view or leaves it unknown (legacy releases).
